input.title: Give the colour filter dropdown an accessible name that matches its visible label
input.rationale: The page shows the text "Filter by colour" (line 13) right before the dropdown, but the <label> isn't connected to it. It has no for attribute and doesn't wrap the dropdown, so screen readers announce the dropdown with no name. I can only edit the dropdown itself, so this patch adds aria-label="Filter by colour". It uses the same words as the visible label, which keeps speech-input users able to say it and keeps what's seen and heard the same. A better fix is outside what I can edit: add for="g-filter" to the <label> on line 13, then remove this aria-label. A person should check this with a screen reader. This change doesn't prove the page is accessible.
